learning_outcomes.text: Choose and use the right collection types effectively
Write and bound generic types and methods safely
Process data with the Streams API and collectors
Use functional interfaces and method references idiomatically
Build correct concurrent code with executors and synchronisation
Diagnose and avoid common concurrency and performance pitfalls
